description: Search InvestorMatch's public directory of venture capital firms. Filter by firm name (query), stage, sector and HQ location; results are sorted alphabetically, 25 per page (up to page 20). Each result has the firm's stages, sectors, check size, a thesis summary and a link to its InvestorMatch profile. The accepted stage, sector and location values are listed by list_investor_filters, and a firm's full profile is in get_investor.

location.description: A location slug from list_investor_filters, e.g. "london".

query.description: Part of the firm's name, e.g. "sequoia".

name: search_investors
title: Search investors
